name: M15 prior-London-session extreme outward-cross follow and fade screening batch

source_references.citation: Brock, Lakonishok and LeBaron (1992), Simple Technical Trading Rules and the Stochastic Properties of Stock Returns, Journal of Finance 47(5), 1731-1764
source_references.supports: The previously opened paper supports only historical daily trading-range-break informativeness in Dow data. It does not establish this prior-London-session M15 FX rule, modern cost survival, fade sign, or transfer.

research.evidence_summary: This is an original compact cross-session adaptation. The inspected historical paper motivates treating a completed range extreme as a falsifiable reference, while both response signs are tested and no profitability prior is claimed.

feasibility.rationale: Requires only completed M1 OHLC, deterministic Europe/London weekday/session construction, supported signal-close fills and same-day exits. An incomplete immediately preceding weekday suppresses the current day, avoiding holiday inference; V2 compatibility remains unconfirmed.

market.session: Reference is the immediately preceding Europe/London weekday's complete 09:00-15:00 M15 session; current signals use completed M15 bars ending 09:30 through 13:45 and exits are due no later than 15:00

data.frequency: Interval-start M1 OHLC aggregated into Europe/London wall-clock M15 intervals
data.minimum_history: Fixed V2 development data only, with a complete 24-bar reference session on the immediately preceding London weekday plus 98 valid observed M15 closes through current t; current event bars t-1 and t must be physically adjacent
preprocessing: Map each UTC M1 timestamp through IANA Europe/London and build wall-clock M15 intervals
Treat M1 timestamp ts as [ts,ts+1 minute) and require 15 consecutive unique valid candles per M15 bar
Valid OHLC is finite and positive with high>=max(open,close), low<=min(open,close), high>=low; duplicates invalidate aggregation

For current London date D, define Dprev as the immediately preceding Monday-Friday calendar date, skipping only Saturday/Sunday; require all 24 M15 bars ending 09:15 through 15:00 on Dprev or suppress all D signals
Set prior_high=max(high) and prior_low=min(low) over those 24 bars; require prior_high>prior_low
Compute observed-sequence TR from previous observed close, seed Wilder ATR(96) from first 96 valid TRs, recur ATR_i=(95*ATR_{i-1}+TR_i)/96, and freeze through current t-1
Use canonical UTC storage and IANA DST rules; never infer or skip an absent weekday as a holiday
dependencies: V2 resolved signal-time spread, commission and slippage
limitations: Historical daily-equity evidence does not transfer directly
Prior-session extrema may be arbitrary for decentralized FX
Suppressing incomplete prior weekdays can omit holidays without identifying them
Six correlated symbols/four cells are not independent

hypothesis.behavior: The first completed current-session M15 close moving from inside the immediately preceding London weekday's high-low interval to strictly outside one extreme may continue or fade over 30-60 minutes.
hypothesis.mechanism: Completed prior-session extremes may concentrate remembered stop and limit interest; an outward close could reveal either order-flow continuation or failed discovery.
works_when: One response sign survives both holds and costs
fails_when: Breaks are spread or volatility artifacts
falsifiable_predictions: Both hold cells for one response mode are positive normal/doubled
The 60-minute center is positive in both UTC halves and at least three symbols
Both cells survive common five-date removal

definitions.name: prior_session_range
definitions.formula: prior_high=max(H_j), prior_low=min(L_j) over exactly 24 valid Dprev M15 bars ending 09:15..15:00 London
definitions.timing: Fully known before current D 09:00; require prior_high>prior_low

definitions.name: outward_cross_direction
definitions.formula: +1 iff prior_low<=close_{t-1}<=prior_high AND close_t>prior_high; -1 iff prior_low<=close_{t-1}<=prior_high AND close_t<prior_low; otherwise 0
definitions.timing: Known at completed current-session t close; t-1 and t physically adjacent and both on D

definitions.name: first_cross_gate
definitions.formula: eligible only for the chronologically first t ending 09:30..13:45 on D with outward_cross_direction nonzero; ignore crosses outside that window, and once an eligible cross is observed consume the symbol-day for every cell
definitions.timing: Causal symbol-day state shared only as an event marker; both t-1 and t are within the current 09:00-15:00 session and no later eligible re-entry event occurs that day

definitions.name: atr96_prior
definitions.formula: Wilder ATR(96) through t-1 over valid observed true ranges
definitions.timing: Frozen before signal t; require finite positive

definitions.name: trade_side
definitions.formula: outward_cross_direction for FOLLOW_CROSS and -outward_cross_direction for FADE_CROSS
definitions.timing: Mechanical mapping at first eligible cross

entries.long_condition: complete Dprev range AND first eligible-window outward cross on D AND ((direction=+1 AND FOLLOW_CROSS) OR (direction=-1 AND FADE_CROSS)) AND cell flat
entries.short_condition: complete Dprev range AND first eligible-window outward cross on D AND ((direction=-1 AND FOLLOW_CROSS) OR (direction=+1 AND FADE_CROSS)) AND cell flat
entries.signal_time: Close of current London M15 interval ending 09:30 through 13:45 on weekday when signal time plus holding_minutes<=15:00
entries.execution_details: Enter at final M1 chart/bid close of completed t; V2 applies resolved/fallback spread, commission and slippage. Entry candle cannot trigger new stop; management starts next M1.
entries.order_type: Market order at supported signal-close execution
restrictions: Exactly one shared first eligible-window cross event per symbol-day across all cells; crosses before 09:30 or after 13:45 are ignored
One open position per symbol per cell
No pyramiding or later eligible recross event
Dprev must be immediately preceding London weekday and complete; never substitute an older observed date
t-1/t must be adjacent bars wholly within the current 09:00-15:00 session

exits.stop_loss: Long bid-chart stop=signal_close_bid-atr96_prior; short=signal_close_bid+atr96_prior. Long triggers bid, short executable ask; adverse gaps fill at worse executable open with costs.
exits.time_exit: Exit at M1 close ending exactly signal_time plus holding_minutes; invalid M1 in (entry_time,due_exit_time] fails affected cells; valid due bar resolves STOP_LOSS before TIME_EXIT
exits.maximum_holding: At most 60 minutes and never after 15:00 Europe/London
exits.end_of_session: No entry matures after 15:00; post-entry defects fail only affected cells

risk.position_sizing: Each cell owns isolated portfolio; same-timestamp symbols within cell size from common pre-entry equity so chart stop risk is 0.25% before costs; no state crosses cells except the immutable shared event identity.
risk.gross_exposure_limit: Per cell at most six symbols and 1.50% aggregate initial stop risk; no cap shared across four portfolios
risk.leverage: Use lower of stop-risk size and V2 limits; skip unrepresentable size
risk.concurrent_positions: Within each cell one per symbol and six total; four cells independently track positions, equity and failures

experiment.baseline: complete prior-session range/first outward cross/one-ATR stop; FOLLOW_CROSS; hold=60
robustness_tests: Report all four cells and retain full breadth ledger
Report symbols and UTC-midpoint halves; midpoint close belongs first half
Double spread, commission and slippage individually
For each mode center hold=60 remove five best normal-cost London dates from both hold cells; require both normal/doubled net R positive
For both cells use eligible London weekdays including zero-event days and 10000 circular five-date bootstrap resamples seed 2026016; center lower bound must exceed zero
Mode advances only if hold=60 center and hold=30 neighbor both pass
Report suppressed current dates by missing/invalid Dprev session and never replace Dprev with an older observed date
costs: Use resolved/fallback spread, commission and slippage at each fill
benchmarks: Opposite response mode on identical first crosses
experiment.multiple_testing: Count all 324 selectable R007-R016 cells, two R008 diagnostics, and named prior-session-extreme/range-break trials including I-11, I-30, I-37, I-41/I-42 and I-46. Cross-batch promotion uses the full ledger; incomplete IDs prohibit confirmation; no best-cell/family rescue.
rejection_criteria: Reject mode unless both holds positive normal/doubled
Reject if center non-positive either UTC half or fewer than three symbols positive each half
Reject if center fewer than 300 trades
Reject if five-date removal makes either cell non-positive
Reject if center bootstrap lower bound not above zero
Reject promotion on required-cell data failure
Never access holdout without explicit authorization for separately frozen version

pseudocode: Build valid London M15 bars causally.
For each D require exactly 24 valid reference bars on immediately preceding weekday Dprev; otherwise suppress D.
Freeze prior_high/prior_low before D; maintain ATR96 through current t-1.
Within signal closes ending 09:30..13:45 find the first adjacent-bar inside-to-strictly-outside close cross; ignore out-of-window crosses and consume the symbol-day only on that first eligible cross.
Map follow/fade and enter flat cells at signal close.
From next M1 process stop before due exit; fail only affected cells.
Publish four cells, suppressions and full robustness/ledger rows.
required_libraries: existing V2 candle, cost, fill and R-accounting components
edge_cases: boundary equality at close_t is not outward
close_t-1 may equal a boundary but must be inside inclusive
t-1/t adjacency and containment within current session required
crosses before 09:30 or after 13:45 do not consume the event
first eligible event is consumed even if a cell is unavailable
implementation.computational_requirements: One causal pass per symbol with one frozen daily reference and isolated four-cell portfolios.
known_backtester_gaps: Queue waits for V2 prior-weekday session, M15/fill and result-ledger compatibility confirmation
